name: roots_compressor_10l
title: Roots compressor, 10 L (exercise 2 bis)
summary: Teaching exercise for a 10 L Roots compressor tested at 1.4 bar discharge, with a volumetric efficiency of 85 % and a mechanical efficiency of 95 %. The equation window is that test point, with an inlet orifice and a leakage nozzle; adapted from the original (orifice area 0.004601 m², the author's commented value: the 5 cm orifice of the original chokes below the fresh-charge flow).

verification.summary: Adapted main file (orifice area 0.004601 m², the author's commented value) vs the EES stored solution with the Air h/s reference offsets: 43/50 values agree (max 9.65e-4); the 7 others are the adapted area and the throat state, which in the store is not a solution (P_thr < 0). Variant no_inlet_drop: 34/34 after the same offsets (max 3.22e-4).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of R2 - EX 2 - SB - Bis.EES (50 values; operating point of the author's trial with A_thr = 0.004601 m2); variant: EES stored solution of MSTh-SB-R2-Ex2.EES (34 values).
verification.notes: Adaptation: the original 5 cm orifice (A_thr = 0.0019635 m2) has no solution: the isentropic throat chokes at 0.463 kg/s (ideal-gas Air, P_crit 52.8 kPa) while epsilon_v imposes 0.505 kg/s; Newton stops at residual 3.438, Try Harder at 0.0242. The author's comment flags the problem; the stored solution is the trial M_dot_l = 0.1*M_dot whose inlet area the author wrote as 0.004601 m2, and the EES guess column of the six throat variables is exactly the CoolSolve throat state. Compared with compare_solution.py after shifting the 8 stored h_*/s_* by +125870.5776559 J/kg and -1814.866798521 J/kg-K (CoolSolve - EES for Air at 20 C, 1e5 Pa). Balance checks: inlet throttling at constant total enthalpy, isentropic leakage nozzle, mixing balance closed, epsilon_s < 1. Solves in 27 iterations from the shipped .initials; from the default guesses only Try Harder converges (549 iterations). Variant: 26/34 raw, 34/34 after the offsets.
